reason: First global pack, with no handlers yet. A global handler needs fire fixtures from two apps (section 5 §12.6), and only kvfcu has fixtures, so every M06 handler sits in the app:kvfcu pack, as in section 5 §15.2. The blank_page handler of section 5 §15.1 waits for a real blank-page fixture: on kvfcu the banner and menu frames keep showing text, so a no-text detector cannot be tested there.
